tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis gsal bar byed pa nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba

rgyal ba rgod tshang mgon po rdo rjes mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ yod dang med pas stong la rtag dang chad pas stong*/ snang dang stong pas stong la gcig dang du mas stong*/ lta dang lta min gyis stong sgom dang tha mal stong*// bya dang mi byed stong dang 'khor gsum kun tu stong*// snang dang snang med stong pa ye shes rgyun gyis stong*// rtog dang rtog med stong la 'khor dang 'das pas stong*// stong dang rten 'byung dbyer med dge sdig 'bras bu 'byin// thams cad stong pa yin phyir 'khrul snang ldog tu btub// ma byas yul med stong dang rang stong lhan cig skyes// gdod nas yod par stong pa bla ma'i drin gyis shes// rnam kun mchog ldan zung 'jug dngos po'i gshis// med pa'i stong pa 'dra min nor sa yod// ces pa stong nyid rdo rje'i tshig drug ma zhes bya ba don dam rnal du mtshon pa'i yi ge'o/// / stong nyid rdo rje'i tshig drug ma bkrol ba bzhugs// na mo ratna gu ru/ stong nyid rdo rje'i tshig drug ni/ gzhi'i stong lugs gnyis/ lam gyi stong lugs gnyis/ 'bras bu'i stong lugs gnyis/ stong pa'i 'thad ldan gnyis/ stong pa gtan la dbab pa'i thabs gnyis/ stong pa'i skyon yon gnyis so// dang po chos thams cad kyi chos nyid ci yang ma yin pa rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa zhes bya ba'i don ston pa ste/ spyir stong pa la yod pa la ltos pa'i med pa lta bu'i phyogs gcig pa'i stong pa dang*/ ka pā li bcud kyis stong pa'am/ bum pa chus stong pa lta bu'i nyi tshe ba'i stong pa dang*/ snang ba bkag pa'i stong pa lta bu gcig pa bkag pa'i stong pa dang*/ stong pa dang stong pa'i rnam gzhag bgrangs pa'i rnam grangs kyi stong pa la sogs pa/ mdor na stong pa zhes pa med pa'am ma grub pa gcig la blo rtse gtad pa'i phyogs 'dzin gyi shes pa de rnams 'di'i dgongs pa ma yin zhing*/

'dir chos thams cad kyi chos nyid ci yang ma yin pa de nyid/ chos thams cad kyi dngos gzhir gnas pa la rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa zhes bya ste/ rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ting 'dzin ni// stong pa nyid du rgyal bas gsungs// gang gis stong nyid mi shes pa// de yis mya ngan 'das mi shes// gang phyir dngos dang dngos med pa// 'dzin pa stong pa min zhes brjod// zhes pa dang*/ rgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud las/ rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med// bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can// zhes pa dang*/ sdud pa las/ yod dang med pa 'di gnyis med pa'i chos yin ste// byang chub sems dpa' gang gis 'di shes nges par 'byung*// zhes pa la sogs pa 'byung ste/ mdor na nang pa sangs rgyas pas brjod par bya ba'i don gyi snying po stong pa nyid yin zhing*/ de ma rtogs pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'thob pas nyan thos rang yang mngon du mi byed par bshad do// de la dang po gzhi'i stong lugs gnyis ni/ yod dang med pas stong la rtag dang chad pas stong*// snang dang stong pas stong la gcig dang du mas stong*// zhes pa ste/ sher snying las gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid kyang gzugs so// gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin no// stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no// zhes pas/ de yang gzugs stong pa'o zhes pa ni/ yod pas stong*/ rtag pas stong*/ snang bas stong*/ du mas stong*/ dngos pos stong pa'i stong pa yin la/ stong pa nyid gzugs so zhes pa ni/ med pas stong*/ chad pas stong*/ stong pas stong*/ gcig gis stong*/ dngos med kyis stong pa'i stong pa ste/ de gnyis sngon la snang bar shar nas/ de nas stong par thim pa'am/ sngon la stong pa yin pa la/ de phyis snang bar shar ba lta bu ma yin te/ snang ba las logs na stong pa med cing*/ stong pa las logs na snang ba med de/

snang stong gnyis 'du 'bral med pa ste/ de nyid las/ gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no// zhes pa de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba yin te/ dngos po'i chos su skye ba med pa ni gzugs stong pa/ dngos med kyi phyogs su 'gag pa med pa stong pa nyid gzugs so/ tha dad kyi chos la gnas pa med pa ni gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin pa'o// zhes gsungs/ mdor na chos nyid ci yang ma yin pa ste/ yod pa yang ma yin/ med pa yang ma yin/ rtag pa yang ma yin/ chad pa yang ma yin/ snang ba'ang ma yin/ stong pa'ang ma yin/ dngos po'ang ma yin/ dngos med kyang ma yin/ 'khor ba'ang ma yin/ 'das pa'ang ma yin/ ci yang ma yin pas phyogs gcig tu ci yang yin pas stong la/ phyogs gcig tu ci yang ma yin pas phyogs med du ci yang yin pa ste/ de nyid la rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa zhes bya'o// des na stong pa dang rten 'brel dbyer med pa ste/ klu sgrub kyis/ gang gis rten cing 'brel 'byung bar/ 'gag pa med pa skye med pa// zhes rgya cher gsungs/ de'ang chos nyid ci yang ma yin pas stong pa/ chos can cir yang 'char bas rten 'brel/ ci yang ma yin pas cir yang 'char la/ cir yang 'char bas ci yang ma yin pa ste dbyer med pa'o// des na stong nyid rten 'brel du ma go na stong pa chad ltar 'gro la/ rten 'brel stong par ma go na las rgyur smra bar 'gro bas/ de gnyis gnad gcig tu gtan la 'beb pa de shin tu zab pa'i brjod bya ste/ de'i don mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams nas mang du gsungs te/ klu sgrub kyis/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i/ chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// de phyir stong pa ma gtogs pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// zhes tha mi dad du gsungs pa dang*/ zla ba sgron me'i mdo las/ gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes// de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin// rkyen la rag las gang de stong pa de// gang gis stong nyid shes de bag yod yin// zhes pa dang*/

klu sgrub kyis/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang*// de ni stong pa nyid du 'dod// de ni rkyen las skyes pa ste// de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no// zhes stong pa'i rten 'brel du bshad la/ nam mkha' che rgyud las/ khyad par ci yang mtshungs pa la// las so zhes ni rnam par btags// ci ste las kyi dbang gyur na// rang byung ye shes yod ma yin// zhes rgyu 'bras stong par bshad pa'o// de ltar chos nyid ci yang ma yin zhing*/ ci yang mi gnas pas tha snyad kyi gdags sa ma rnyed cing*/ blo yul de byar ma btub de la stong pa nyid ces bya/ de bzhin nyid ces bya/ skye med spros bral/ 'od gsal/ don dam pa'i bden pa/ chos dbyings sam chos nyid/ shes bya la sogs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs te/ don la byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig yin no// gnyis pa lam gyi stong lugs gnyis ni/ lta dang lta min gyis stong sgom dang tha mal stong*// bya dang mi byed stong dang 'khor gsum kun tu stong*// zhes pa ste dang po lta ba lta min gyis stong pa// lta ba rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gtan la phebs pas de'i lta ba 'di ces pa yongs dpyod kyi bsgrub bya med pas lta bas stong*/ 'di min zhes rnam dpyod kyis dgag bya med pas lta min gyis stong ste/ phyogs 'dzin gyi lta ba thams cad las grol ba'o// de yang klu sgrub kyis/ stong pa nyid kyi lta thos nas// la la'i lta ba ma zhig na/ gsor mi rung gi lta ba can// sman pas bor ba'i nad pa bzhin// zhes pa dang*/ arya de bas/ lta ba thams cad 'joms mdzad pa'i// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje gur las/ lta ba rnams las zlog pa dang*// bdag tu lta ba 'tshol rnams kyis// bdag zhen bsam pa zlog pa dang*// zhen bsam lta ba zlog pa'i phyir// stong pa rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs// zhes pas gong gi phyogs gcig tu ci yang ma yin la/

phyogs med du ci yang yin pa'i gnad kyis/ 'dir lta ba la 'di yin dang*/ 'di min gyi bza' gtad med pas mtha' brgyad kyi phyogs 'dzin rang grol ba ni lta ba phyin ci ma log pa'o// zhang rin po ches/ yin pa gang yang med pa la// ma yin pa yang gang yang med// yin pa dang ni min pa gnyis// phan tshun 'dzin pas ltos pa ste// ltos pa zad la lta ba med// ces pa'i don no// sgom gyis stong la tha mal gyis stong pa'i// rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa ni/ sems rang lugs su bzhag pas rnam rtog rang 'gags su 'gags pa'i dus na ngos bzung med pa'i shes pa/ sgro gtags kyi spros pa dang bral bas sgom gyis stong la/ rang rig yul med du gsal ba la rtog med du nges shes skyes pas tha mal gyis stong pa'o// yang 'di sgom yin no zhes blos byas la sgom rgyu gcig kyang med pas sgom gyis stong pa'o// 'di sgom min no zhes pa spang bya'am dor bya gcig kyang mi 'dug pas tha mal gyis stong pa'o// stong nyid rtogs pas grol gyur gyis// sgom pa lhag ma de don yin// zhes pa'i don no// bya byed kyis stong pa mi byed pas stong pa'i spyod pa rnam pa kun ldan ni bya ba byed pas stong ste/ sbyin pa la sogs pa nyams su len pa'i dus nyid na/ btang bya'i yul gtong mkhan gyi bdag btang pa'i phan yon gsum rang gi ngo bos stong zhing yod ma myong la/ bya ba mi byed pas stong ste/ stong pa de nyid sbyin pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung por shar cing ma bkag la ya ma bral bar spyod pa'o// de ltar bya ba byed pa ltar ma 'gags la bya ba byed pa'i ngo bos stong pa'i bya ba byed mi byed kyis bcings grol med pa'i stong nyid de/ 'phags pa gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa'i mdo las/ de la rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ gang sbyin pa dang ma bral ba/ gang tshul khrims dang ma bral ba/

bzod pa dang ma bral ba/ brtson 'grus dang ma bral ba/ bsam gtan dang ma bral ba/ shes rab dang ma bral ba/ thabs dang ma bral ba'o// zhes rgya cher gsungs pa'i don no// de lta bu'i lam rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid de thabs shes rab don dam kun rdzob bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa dbyer med pa ste/ phyogs gcig tu zhen pa las grol ba'i lam ma nor zhing rnam par dag pa'o// de ltar lam sgro bkur gyi mtha' dang bral ba'i de nyid zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa dbu ma'i lam nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i byang chub chen po mngon du byed do// gsum pa de'i 'bras bu'i stong lugs gnyis ni/ snang dang snang med stong pa ye shes rgyun gyis stong*// rtog dang rtog med stong la 'khor dang 'das pas stong*// zhes pa ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la snang bas stong ste/ zhen pas bltas pa'i 'khrul snang mi mnga'/ snang med kyis stong ste rang snang rang ngo shes pas rang gsal ye shes kyi snang ba 'gag pa med/ ye shes yod pas stong ste/ ye shes dngos can gyis yang dag tu grub pa med la/ med pas stong ste yod med sgro bkur gyi mtha' dang bral ba de nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi dngos gzhir bzhugs pa'o// rtog pas stong ste sems sems byung rnam shes 'du shes mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa mi mnga'/ yul yul can gyis thugs rje dang 'phrin las las rnam rtog mi mnga'/ rtog med kyis stong ste nyan thos kyi 'gog pa'i 'bras bu lta bu ma yin ste/ so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes kyis shes bya'i dkyil 'khor la mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas shing*/ dus gsum sngon du mkhyen la/ dmigs med kyi snying rjes/ rtsol med kyi 'phrin las srid mtha'i bar du 'byung ba'o// 'khor bas stong ste/ shes rab chen pos srid la mi gnas/ 'das pas stong ste snying rje chen pos zhi ba la mi gnas pa'o// de ltar gzhi lam gyi nyes pa zad pa'i sangs rgyas de la/

'ga' zhig 'khrul snang gzhi dang lam gyi shes sgrib bkag nas snang ba yod med dang*/ ye shes rgyun chad ma chad dang rtog pa yod med la sogs pa rtsod pa 'byung bar 'dug ste/ phyogs gcig gi mu ru 'dzin pa de dag 'bras bu rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa ma go ba yin no/ rdo rje gcod pa'i mdo las/ gang gis nga la gzugs su mthong*// gang gis nga la sgrar shes pa// log par mthong la zhugs pa'i phyir// skye bo des ni nga mi mthong*// 'dren pa rnams ni chos kyi sku// chos sku mthong bya ma yin no// zhes pa'i don no// bzhi pa stong pa'i mtha' ldan gnyis ni/ stong dang rten 'byung dbyer med dge sdig 'bras bu 'byin// thams cad stong pa yin phyir 'khrul snang ldog tu btub// ces pa ste/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid ci yang ma yin pa'i gnad kyis rkyen gyis cir yang 'char zhing cir yang byar btub pa de/ bsam pa'i rang gzugs bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan stong pa la stong pa'i chos 'byung bas/ dkar nag gi rgyu 'bras til 'bru tsam yang chud mi za zhing ma 'dres par 'bras bu 'byin pa ste/ las brgya pa las/ lus can rnams kyi las rnams ni// bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi 'dza'// tshogs shing dus la babs pa na// 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur// ces so// 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rkyen gyis 'gyur te/ phyogs gcig tu ci yang ma yin pas/ phyogs med du ci yang 'char bas na/ kun rdzob kyi chos 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras ci rnyed pa thams cad kyang stong pa yin pas 'byung la/ yang chos nyid ci yang ma yin pa stong pa yin pa'i gnad kyis 'khrul pa ldog cing*/ mya ngan las 'da' ru yang btub pa de/ chos thams cad la rtag brtan ther zug mi 'gyur ba'i dngos po sa zin ko 'thas yang dag tu grub pa gang yang med pas/ sdig pa bshags su btub la/ dge ba bsngo ru btub/ 'khrul snang ldog tu btub ste/

sdig pa rang bzhin med cing ma grub par shes pa ni bshags pa'i mchog /dge ba rang bzhin med cing ma grub par shes pa ni zag med kyi dge ba'i mchog yin cing*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med cing ma grub pa ni chos sku'i dngos gzhir gnas la/ de ltar shes pa ye shes ste/ mdor na stong nyid rang bzhin med pa'i gnad kyis 'tshang rgyar btub cing*/ mi rgya ba'i rang dbang med pa'o// stong pa dang mi rtog pa'ang phug gcig cing*/ de nyid chos dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin la/ chos nyid dus las 'das shing*/ de nyid shes pa'i ye shes de dus la dbang bsgyur bas/ dus bskal pa dang skad cig ma la khyad par med par dus gsum rang mngon du rtog med du mkhyen pa dang*/ snang ba la dbang bsgyur bas stong gsum nyung 'brur chud pa dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga nas zhing khams bye ba 'gyed pa la sogs pa/ stong pa nyid ci yang ma yin pa'i gnad kyis 'byung ba ste/ lugs ldog mya ngan las 'das pa'i rten 'brel thams cad kyang stong nyid yin pa'i gnad kyis byung ba'o// rgyal ba'i yum las/ gzugs rtag brtan ther zug mi 'gyur ba'i dngos po zhig yin na ni/ theg pa chen po 'dis kyang lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan cing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so// lnga pa stong pa de gtan la dbab lugs kyi tshig rkang gnyis ste/ ma byas yul med stong dang rang stong lhan cig skyes// gdod nas yod par stong pa bla ma'i drin gyis shes// zhes pa ste/ stong nyid de yang chos gsum dang ldan pa ste/ rang stong*/ ye stong*/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa'o// rang stong pas/ yul med de stong bya phyi ru bzhag nas/ stong mkhan nang du lus pa lta bu ma yin ste/ snang rig rang stong pa'o// ye stong pa dus glo bur du ma byung ba ste/ sngon la snang ba byung ba la de nas stong par song ba lta bu ma yin te/

gdod ma nas stong zhing dngos po'i phyogs su skye ma myong ba'o// rang bzhin gyis stong pa ni byed pa po gzhan gyis ma byas pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyis bcos nas stong du bcug pa'am/ sems can gyis bslad nas stong du bcug pa'am/ lam gyis sbyangs nas stong du bcug pa'o// bla mas gdams ngag che nas byas pa'am/ slob ma shes rab che nas byung ba'am/ snang ba bkag nas stong pa sgrub pa lta bu ma yin ste/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong*/ ngo bos stong*/ dus gsum dus med par stong*/ snang ba'i dus nyid na ngo bos stong pa yin no// brgyad stong pa las/ rab 'byor gzugs ni ngo bo nyid kyis stong ngo*// rang gis mtshan nyid kyis stong pa yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa dang*/ yab sras mjal ba las/ chos nyid 'di dag thams cad ni dus gsum du mnyam pa nyid kyis mnyam pa dag ste/ 'das pa'i dus na yang chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis med pas na da ltar byung ba'i bar du ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'o// zhes gsungs so// de lta bu'i stong nyid de dngos po'i chos thams cad dang gnyis su med par rang gi ngo bor lhan cig skyes pa ste/ brtag gnyis las/ lhan cig skyes pa gang skyes pa// lhan cig skyes pa de brjod bya// rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod// rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig /ces pa'i don no// de lta bu'i stong nyid lhan cig skyes pa de tha snyad kyis gtan la mi phebs shing*/ rtog ge'i spyod yul ma yin pas thos bsam gyi shes rab kyis don spyi'i rnam pa tsam gtan la phebs su zin kyang*/ rang mtshan mngon sum du rtogs par mi 'gyur bas/ bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs sam brda thabs khyad par can la rten nas skye ba'i mtshan mas skye med rtogs par 'gyur zhing*/ dngos po'i chos la brten nas dngos med kyi chos nyid rtogs par 'gyur gyi/ ye nas yod pa'i ye shes khong nas sad par byed do// drug pa stong pa'i skyon yon gnyis ni/

rnam kun mchog ldan zung 'jug dngos po'i gshis/ med pa'i stong pa 'dra min nor sa yod// zhes pa ste/ rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa phyogs thams cad kyis stong zhing*/ spros pas dben pa'i rang bzhin can de ni/ gnas lugs dngos po'i gshis yin la/ de ji lta bar rtogs pa'i shes rab de ni myur du 'khor ba las grol zhing mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba yin no// klu sgrub kyis/ yod pa po ni bde 'gror 'gro// med pa po ni ngan 'gror 'gro// yang dag ji bzhin yongs shes na// gnyis la mi brten thar par 'gyur/ zhes pa dang*/ rnam 'grel las kyang*/ byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir// nyes mang shin tu tshar gcod min// nyes kun de yi rtsa ba can// de yang 'jigs tshogs lta bas skyes// stong nyid lta dang de 'gal bas// de las byung ba'i nyes kun spongs// zhes pa dang*/ bzhi brgya pa las/ shes rab chung bas chos 'di la// the tshom za bar yang mi 'gyur// the tshom za ba tsam zhig gis// srid pa hrul por byas par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ gnas lugs kyi gshis stong nyid du bzhugs pa yin la/ de ma nor bar rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis lam thams cad zag pa med par sgrub cing*/ myur du 'khor ba las sgrol zhing*/ myang 'das mngon du byed pa yin no// med pa'i stong pa zhes pa ni/ stong pa dang 'dra min gyi nor sa yod pa yin pas stong pa zhes pa cang med phyam chad gcig tu go na blo gros rmongs shing*/ lta ba shin tu nor ba yin te de la dgongs nas/ sdud pa las/ phung 'di stong zhes rtog na byang chub sems dpa' ni// mtshan ma la spyod skye med gnas la dad ma yin// ces pa dang*/ sa ra has/ dngos por rtog pa phyugs dang 'dra bar spyod// dngos med rtog pa de bas kyang ni blun// zhes pa dang*/ yum las/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ces pa la sogs pa mang du gsungs/ klu sgrub kyis/

stong pa nyid la lta nyes na/ shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur// ji ltar sbrul la bzung nyes dang*// rigs sngags log par sgrub pa bzhin// zhes pa dang*/ chos spyod mngon rtogs las/ stong pa'i bdag po stong par 'gro// zhes pa la sogs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams nas mang du gsungs te/ de thams cad stong pa la med par 'dzin pa'i chad par lta ba la nye bas/ thabs la bskur ba 'debs pa rnams la dgongs pa yin te/ des na stong pa dang med pa ma nor bar rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong par gnyis med rten cing 'brel 'byung gi don khong du chud par bya'o// yang rgyal ba'i yum las/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'dris par bya'o// stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin mngon du mi bya'o// zhes pa dang*/ dkon rtsegs las/ seṅge gangs la mi 'jigs mod// me chen mthong na 'jigs pa skyes// de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' yang*// chos gzhan gang la'ang mi 'jigs kyang*// stong pa nyid la 'jigs pa skye// zhes pa'i don yang bsam par bya'o// stong nyid rdo rje tshig drug ma'i zhal gdams che long tsam yig ger bkod pa// //
